name: Colors
summary: Browsable collection of 992 hand-picked color palettes from ColourLovers; click a swatch to copy its hex.
description: An open-source Next.js front end that browses nearly 1,000 hand-picked color palettes sourced from ColourLovers. Each palette is a row of swatches — click one to copy its hex value. The code lives on GitHub, where the repo has 4 stars and 2 commits, and the app runs live at colors.robi.work.
contains: click any swatch to copy its hex value
